interpretation: The reference reports zero-affected-row RLS update/delete as successful 204/no-data, while native rejects missing and foreign records with 403. Both reject tested constraints; PostgreSQL exposes SQLSTATEs 23505/23502/23514 with status 409/400/400, while native status is 400 for these constraints. These are raw backend differences; the approved policy preserves backend error details rather than mapping them.
evidenceCorrection: Removed an unexecuted reference boolean-CHECK claim: the reference insert vectors did not include completed=2 and Postgres declares a boolean type, not the native integer CHECK. The new update probe tests the reference type error separately.
